# StudentDocs Image to PDF Converter

> Free, 100% private, client-side JPG/PNG to PDF converter for students, job applicants, and educators.

## Capabilities
- Converts multiple images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a single, clean PDF file.
- Client-side execution using jsPDF: zero server uploads, 100% data privacy.
- Customizable page margins, orientation (Portrait/Landscape), and page formats (A4, Letter).
- Built specifically for college assignments, exam application document uploads, and notes packaging.

## Core URLs
- Application Home: https://img2pdf.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://img2pdf.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
